commentary.text: 121' That was the last kick of the penalty shootout, with a winner finally emerging.
121' Goal! Jose Canale (Paraguay) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Manuel Neuer into the roof of the net.
121' Jonathan Tah (Germany) fails to score from the penalty kick. His shot goes just a few inches over the crossbar.
121' Manuel Neuer anticipates the direction of the penalty by Fabian Balbuena (Paraguay). He attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
121' Goal! Nadiem Amiri (Germany) lashes the penalty into the bottom right corner, giving the keeper no chance.
121' Antonio Sanabria (Paraguay) can't convert the spot kick. It goes narrowly wide of the left post.

121' Nick Woltemade (Germany) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom right corner. Orlando Gill anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
121' GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Matias Galarza (Paraguay) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Manuel Neuer no chance!
121' Goal! Jamal Musiala (Germany) calmly steps up and smashes the ball into the bottom left corner.
121' Gustavo Gomez (Paraguay) steps up and confidently powers his spot-kick into the bottom right corner.
121' Goal! Joshua Kimmich (Germany) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Orlando Gill into the bottom left corner.
121' Goal! Mauricio (Paraguay) slams home the penalty with a precise shot which goes inside the right post.

121' Kai Havertz (Germany) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the middle of the goal. Orlando Gill anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and just stays where he is to stop his effort.
121' The match will be decided by a penalty shootout. Who will be the winner and who will be the loser?

111' Germany failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
